title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A hearty German-inspired chicken noodle soup made with crunchy vegetables and savory chicken.

ingredients.name: crunchy vegetable mix
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and snow peas

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and sauté until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the noodles and crunchy vegetable mix and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the noodles are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
